translations.web: But the end of all things is near. Therefore be of sound mind, self-controlled, and sober in prayer.
translations.bsb: The end of all things is near. Therefore be clear-minded and sober, so that you can pray.
translations.kjv: But the end of all things is at hand: be ye ➔ therefore sober, and watch unto prayer.
